invariants.lossless: every SUCCESS row decodes voxel-identical with the original decoder
invariants.byte_equal_E0: cape_q1_fast_m0 sha256 == cape_v3frozen_fast_m0 sha256 on 100% of valid primary cells; one mismatch stops the byte-preserving claim

practical_targets.note: project-chosen 5% targets, not a universal journal requirement

metrics.S_T: exp(mean log(T_E0 / T_Eθ)), T = median encode_ns over 7 repeats
metrics.R_M: exp(mean log(M_Eθ / M_E0)), M = peak_after_encode of the fresh-process memory row

statistics.bootstrap: paired cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261107, 95% percentile

C1.reporting: target reached and statistical evidence in separate columns; worst regression shown

secondary.C1_snemi_seen: same metrics on SNEMI3D 32 crops (16 macroblock clusters); previously seen
secondary.C1_hemibrain: descriptive (4 cutouts, one acquisition; CI = timing variation only)
secondary.C2: cape_q1_fast_m0 vs cape_v21_fast_m0 (historical; the v3 gain is not re-counted as new)
secondary.C3: vs q1_fast_weighted_greedy_m0, q1_fast_greedy_local_m0, crackle_pins_opt_corrected_m0, crackle_flat_m0, crackle_pins_fast_m0, compresso_native, neuroglancer_b8(_u32), zstd9: size, time and memory together; streams differ, no byte equality required
secondary.archive: m0/m5 and zstd3/zstd9 never mixed; SAFE counts all candidate encodes

decision_rules: speed improves but memory not -> claim speed only
no C3 advantage beyond stock -> no algorithmic-superiority claim
novelty not separable from prior art -> engineering contribution
